description.value: A cross-sectional voxel-based morphometry study compared regional gray matter volume between young binge drinkers and control subjects, focusing on anatomically defined prefrontal and anterior cingulate regions.

spans.text: In this study, we used MRI and voxel-based morphometry (VBM) employing a region-of-interest (ROI) approach, to examine, based on our previous work, the effects of a persistent (at least three years) binge-pattern of alcohol use on GM volume of DLPFC (specifically, mid-DLPFC) in youths.

description.value: Cross-sectional observational study of university volunteers assigned to binge-drinker and control cohorts.

spans.text: The neuroimaging assessment of participants was performed during their fourth academic year of attendance at the University of Santiago de Compostela, within the framework of a longitudinal study examining the neurocognitive consequences of BD on the young university population

binge drinkers

description.value: Subjects were classified as binge drinkers if they reported drinking six or more standard alcoholic drinks on the same occasion according to the stated frequency and speed criteria, and had maintained this pattern for at least three years.

spans.text: Subjects were classified as binge drinkers (BD) if they reported drinking (i) six or more standard alcoholic drinks (10 g of alcohol according to the Spanish Health Authority's reference) on the same occasion at least once per week, or (ii) six or more standard alcoholic drinks on the same occasion at least once a month and, during these episodes, drank at a speed of consumption of at least three drinks per hour.
The 36 participants who agreed to participate were questioned about their current drinking pattern.

Finally, 32 participants (mean age  = 22.34, SD = 1.04, range 20–24) were selected for neuroimaging assessment: 11 binge drinkers (7 males, 4 females) and 21 non-binge drinkers (10 males, 11 females).
For sample consistency, four BD participants from the longitudinal study who did not report a current binge-drinking pattern of alcohol consumption were excluded from the analysis.
